pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plans had an e3-e4 break with the pawn on e2 and a knight route d2-f1-e3 with the rook on f1. Rewritten as a reversed King's Indian Defence with an extra tempo.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plan had Ne1 with the king on e1 and f4 behind the f3-knight. Rewritten around the KIA set-up and Black's choice of structure.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plans read e4 as Black's move and had ...c5/...b5 controlling the long diagonal. Rewritten.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plans had an e3-e4 route with the pawn on e2, Ne1-d3, and ...dxe4 without e4. Rewritten; reviewer rejection (...Bb7 behind ...c6 and ...d5) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, Neo-Gruenfeld
pages.notes: Plan had Ne1-d3 with the king on e1; plans without side prefixes. Rewritten; reviewer rejection (Catalan named in a ...g6 structure) fixed to the Fianchetto Grünfeld and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, Yugoslav, Main Line
pages.notes: Plans had Ne1-g2 into the bishop and Nd2-f1-e3 through the rook. Rewritten around Nbd2/h3/e4 and ...e5 or ...e6.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, Yugoslav, Main Line, 6.Nbd2 e5
pages.notes: Plans had dxe4 and ...dxe4 without the captures that allow them and a route through the f1-rook. Rewritten with 7.e4 dxe4 8.dxe4.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, Yugoslav, Main Line, 6.Nbd2 e6
pages.notes: Plans had Nf1-g3 through the f1-rook and a g4 advance onto the g4-bishop. Rewritten with 7.h3 Bh5 8.g4 Bg6 9.Nh4.

pages.name: King's Indian Attack: Sicilian Variation
pages.notes: Plans had Nf3-e1-g2 into the e1-rook and g2-bishop and ...Nh5 to challenge the g2-bishop. Rewritten around e5, Nf1, h4 and ...b5-b4.

pages.name: King's Indian Attack: Sicilian Variation
pages.notes: Plan had an e3-e4 route and a knight route through e1 and f1 to g3. Rewritten; reviewer rejection (...Bb7 behind the d5-pawn) fixed and re-reviewed.
